## Step 1: Calculate 66 factorial
<function_calls>
<invoke name="bash">
<parameter name="command">python3 << 'EOF'
import math

# Calculate 66!
factorial_66 = math.factorial(66)
print(f"66! = {factorial_66}")
print(f"Number of digits: {len(str(factorial_66))}")
EOF
</parameter>
</invoke>

<function_calls>
<invoke name="bash">
<parameter name="command">python3 << 'EOF'
import math

# Calculate 66!
factorial_66 = math.factorial(66)

# Convert to string to access individual digits
digits_str = str(factorial_66)

# Display the number
print(f"66! = {factorial_66}")
print(f"\nNumber of digits: {len(digits_str)}")
print(f"\nThe digits are: {digits_str}")
EOF
</parameter>
</invoke>

## Step 2: Sum all the digits
<function_calls>
<invoke name="bash">
<parameter name="command">python3 << 'EOF'
import math

# Calculate 66!
factorial_66 = math.factorial(66)

# Convert to string to access individual digits
digits_str = str(factorial_66)

# Sum all the digits
digit_sum = sum(int(digit) for digit in digits_str)

print(f"66! = {factorial_66}")
print(f"\nBreaking down the digit sum:")
print(f"Individual digits: {', '.join(digits_str)}")
print(f"\nSum of all digits: {digit_sum}")
EOF
</parameter>
</invoke>
</function_calls>

## Step 3: Verify the result
<function_calls>
<invoke name="bash">
<parameter name="command">python3 << 'EOF'
import math

# Verification - recalculate using a different approach
factorial_66 = math.factorial(66)
digits_str = str(factorial_66)

# Method 1: Original calculation
digit_sum_1 = sum(int(digit) for digit in digits_str)

# Method 2: Alternative calculation
digit_sum_2 = sum(map(int, digits_str))

# Method 3: Manual verification by summing groups
digits_list = [int(d) for d in digits_str]
digit_sum_3 = 0
for digit in digits_list:
    digit_sum_3 += digit

print(f"66! = {factorial_66}\n")
print(f"Verification Methods:")
print(f"Method 1 (sum of int comprehension): {digit_sum_1}")
print(f"Method 2 (sum of map): {digit_sum_2}")
print(f"Method 3 (manual loop): {digit_sum_3}")
print(f"\nAll methods agree: {digit_sum_1 == digit_sum_2 == digit_sum_3}")
print(f"\nFinal Answer: {digit_sum_1}")
EOF
</parameter>
</invoke>
</function_calls>
